title: Boot Trace (Library of Ruina)
description: Log-only trace of the loading screen before the opening AMV: when each wait of EntryScene.WaitForAddressableManagerInit ends, the status of every Addressables load, and how long the auto-save notice waits for the opening to load. Changes nothing in the game.

launcher.label: Boot Trace
launcher.note: Writes the progress of the startup loading screen to log.txt. Mod for debugging purposes only.

aeea627ddbd1214764dfef5f965e94a2.reason: EntryScene.<WaitForAddressableManagerInit>d__25.MoveNext, state 1 entry (mov w8,#-1): the first WaitUntil, AddressableManager._init, has ended
EntryScene.<WaitForAddressableManagerInit>d__25.MoveNext, state 2 entry (mov w8,#-1): the second WaitUntil, GlobalGameManager._initialized, has ended
EntryScene.<WaitForAddressableManagerInit>d__25.MoveNext, state 3 entry (ldr x20,[x19,#0x20]): the one-second wait has ended and the opening's load starts

AddressableManager.<LoadAssetCoroutine>d__35<object>.MoveNext, after get_Status (cmp w0,#1): w0 = the handle's status (1 = Succeeded); the game calls onLoadAsset, which ends the load, only on 1 and drops any other status without a message
AutoSavingUI.Update, before the _waitForOpeningLoading check (ldrb w8,[x19,#0x58]): x19 = the AutoSavingUI, once a frame
